results.title: News Flash - Poughkeepsie, NY
results.content: ## Common Council. # This notice is to all residents of the City of Poughkeepsie who utilize City water –. # PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the City of Poughkeepsie Fire Department will be servicing and testing the City fire hydrant system. Be further advised that during the testing period, the water is safe, but should be run until it is clear; use caution when doing white laundry-it is recommended that you should wait a twenty-four (24) to forty-eight (48) hour period after the testing has been completed in the vicinity of your neighborhood. Street-specific list will be posted weekly to the City of Poughkeepsie website prior to testing. • Forbus St between Hooker Ave and S Cherry St. • S Cherry St between Forbus St and College Ave. • S Clinton St between Montgomery St and Hooker Ave. • S Cherry St between Church St and Forbus St. • College Ave between S Cherry St and S Grand Ave.
